decoding: Readout argmax selects a learned value string and serializes one JSON answer. This is structured neural decoding, not unconstrained autoregressive generation. Parent knowledge control gets the same global JSON prefix then greedy decoding; other parent answers use ordinary greedy decoding.
evaluation: New development and final question forms, distinct from all earlier incremental and rehearsal forms. Same trained facts:32development entities,128other final entities. Old skill/conversation probes measure retention only. Independent finals are public and frozen, not secret.
feature_shape: one unpadded user prompt plus the global JSON prefix
purpose: Test whether an independently owned learned value decoder can assimilate new facts through a question-only causal interface while preserving the frozen parent fallback.
router: A bounded explicit namespace: question contains fictional Luma directory and exactly one full admitted roster name. Roster stores names only. Other questions use the unchanged parent. Multi-domain ambiguity and general conversational routing are outside this profile.
selection: One terminal decoder. Commit all development outcomes and decoder identity before finals. Require at least75% new-question correctness, entity-cluster gain lower bound above0.10, zero old correct skill losses, original conversation retention bounds, exact skill fallback and question-only routing. No failing candidate opens finals.
stop: No hyperparameter or data changes inside the frozen run. Preserve failures and retire within the existing allocation deadline. No native activation, token issuance or general assistant-quality claim.
training: All 5120 already admitted directory QA examples. Features are freshly computed with one unpadded question per forward, using no value-bearing token. Fit one joint 128-class ridge decoder in float64. No attribute oracle, retrieved fact mapping, optimizer tuning or evaluation examples.
